hypothesis: Shared-paper-first candidate_pool: a Traditional FDA 510(k) clearance removes a listed medical-device issuer's commercialization constraint; after a conservative 14-calendar-day envelope for FDA's weekly public database inclusion, the issuer should retain positive drift from the next open through the tenth session close.
next_retry_requires: A materially different official device-commercialization source with an audited per-record publication timestamp and issuer-level materiality field
or at least 30 closed forward replacement-value rows from a fixed prospective 510(k) observer; no alias, subtype, availability-lag, cooldown, hold, notional, cost, or window retune
notes: Frozen 4,344 official raw records into 415 exact-mapped events. The fixed policy produced 242 trades across 31 tickers and all three windows, but aggregate EV fell 0.2697 and PnL fell 1,066.78; all three window EVs regressed, old_thin lost 1,645.81, top-five positive contribution was 68.86 percent, and both accepted comparators failed. DSR was not computable because the expected-maximum approximation was negative; it did not affect Gate 4.

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retune the exact applicant whitelist, 510(k) subtype, 14-day availability envelope, issuer-day dedupe, cooldown, hold, notional, costs, or window slices on this frozen response.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A materially different official device-commercialization source with audited per-record publication timing and issuer-level materiality, or at least 30 closed prospective replacement-value rows from a fixed observer.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: Routine Traditional clearances produced 242 broadly distributed trades, but the two-week public-release envelope left aggregate PnL negative, all three window EVs lower, old_thin materially negative, and positive contribution still too concentrated.

prediction.confidence_reason: A genuinely new official source passes conservative Traditional-clearance density in every window (92/75/79 mapped rows, 18/15/16 tickers, top1 14-17%) and warehouse OHLCV covers 33 mapped tickers, but the 14-day public-release envelope can remove immediate catalyst alpha.

rejection_reason: Gate 4 failed aggregate EV and PnL, all three window EVs regressed, old_thin EV/PnL were negative, top-five contribution exceeded 60 percent, and both accepted-distribution comparators were missed.
reopen_condition: Reopen only with an official per-record publication timestamp plus issuer-level materiality evidence, or after a fixed prospective observer has at least 30 closed replacement-value rows. Threshold, alias, subtype, lag, hold, cooldown, notional, cost, and window retunes are forbidden.
